class.name: VehicleServer
class.brief_description: Every vehicle of the world, by its RID: its controller, its cabins, who sits in them and the commands it takes.
class.description: A vehicle is held by its RID and commanded with [method vehicle_send_command]; only a command renews the state dump and announces itself ([signal vehicle_command_received]). Its id (the scenery name in lower case, [method vehicle_get_rid_by_id]) is only for finding it, its name ([method vehicle_get_name]) only for the player to read. What simulates a vehicle is an implementation registered by name ([method implementation_register]) - the extension registers the Mover, an addon may register its own; the controller ([VehicleController]) names the one it runs on. The server steps every vehicle on [SimulationServer]'s clock ([method stepping_advance]). A cabin ([method cabin_create]) is a place in a vehicle people sit in: [PersonServer] persons, each in one role ([enum VehiclePersonRole.Role]).

method.name: cabin_create
method.description: A place people sit in, of nothing yet; attached to a vehicle ([method vehicle_cabin_attach]) it can be entered. A vehicle without a cabin cannot be entered at all.

method.name: cabin_free
method.description: Frees [param cabin]; it is detached from its vehicle first, and whoever sits in it leaves.

method.name: cabin_get_vehicle
method.description: The vehicle [param cabin] is attached to; an empty RID for none.

method.name: cabin_has_person_role
method.description: Whether somebody sits in [param cabin] in [param role] - anybody for [constant VehiclePersonRole.VEHICLE_PERSON_ROLE_ANY].

method.name: cabin_list_persons
method.description: Who sits in [param cabin] in [param role] - everybody for [constant VehiclePersonRole.VEHICLE_PERSON_ROLE_ANY].

method.name: cabin_person_change_role
method.description: [param person], sitting in [param cabin], takes [param role] there. Refused with [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for a person not in the cabin or a role that is no role, and with [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] for the driver's role where somebody else drives.

method.name: cabin_person_enter
method.description: [param person] sits down in [param cabin] in [param role]. Refused - with the reason, and nothing changed - for a person aboard already ([constant ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE]), a cabin of no vehicle or a role that is no role ([constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]), and the driver's seat of a cabin somebody else drives from ([constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE]): one driver a cabin, and taking it over is that one's change of role first.

method.name: cabin_person_leave
method.description: [param person] leaves [param cabin].

method.name: cabin_person_move
method.description: The person over to another cabin, of the same vehicle or another one (a gangway), in the role it has. [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] for a driver going where one already drives.

method.name: controller_configure
method.description: The controller becomes a copy of [param description] (a [VehicleController] with its components - its stored configuration); a vehicle it drives is restarted on it.

method.name: controller_create
method.description: A controller of this server, empty until configured ([method controller_configure]).

method.name: controller_free
method.description: Frees [param controller].

method.name: implementation_get_list
method.description: The names of the registered implementations.

method.name: implementation_register
method.description: What simulates the vehicles whose controller names [param name], by the instance id of its [VehicleImplementationServer].

method.name: implementation_unregister
method.description: Nothing simulates the vehicles whose controller names [param name] any more.

method.name: person_get_cabin
method.description: The cabin [param person] sits in; an empty RID for a person on foot.

method.name: person_get_role
method.description: The role [param person] has where it sits, [constant VehiclePersonRole.VEHICLE_PERSON_ROLE_ANY] for a person on foot.

method.name: person_get_vehicle
method.description: The vehicle of the cabin [param person] sits in; an empty RID for a person on foot.

method.name: stepping_advance
method.description: One step of every vehicle by [param delta] seconds: each implementation is handed its own vehicles, at once. Driven by [SimulationServer]'s clock, and callable directly where the caller wants to decide when it happens.

method.name: stepping_is_enabled
method.description: Whether the vehicles are stepped.

method.name: stepping_set_enabled
method.description: Freezes the step while a scenery is torn down: the vehicles are freed one by one, and stepping a registry that is being emptied is work for nothing.

method.name: vehicle_bind_controller
method.description: [param vehicle] is driven by [param controller] from now on: the controller it had lets go of its simulation, this one takes the scenery's values and starts its own. An empty RID unbinds; binding the same pair again restarts the vehicle's simulation.

method.name: vehicle_broadcast_command
method.description: Sends [param command] to every vehicle that has it. Reports an error when no vehicle does.

method.name: vehicle_cabin_attach
method.description: Makes [param cabin] a part of [param vehicle].

method.name: vehicle_cabin_detach
method.description: [param cabin] is no part of [param vehicle] any more; whoever sits in it leaves first.

method.name: vehicle_component_get
method.description: The component of [param type], as a typed object - a live view on the vehicle, valid while the vehicle is (the shape [method PhysicsServer3D.body_get_direct_state] has). A per-frame reader takes it once and reads its getters; null for a vehicle without one.

method.name: vehicle_create
method.description: Creates a vehicle without a controller.

method.name: vehicle_dump_config
method.description: The configuration of [param vehicle], by name. Not cached: for a reader driven by a name out of the data, never per frame.

method.name: vehicle_dump_state
method.description: Everything [param vehicle] publishes, by name, in one [Dictionary]. Expensive on purpose: a console, a test or a diagnostic asks for it, never a per-frame reader - those take the component that owns the value ([method vehicle_component_get]). Cached until the next step or command.

method.name: vehicle_exists
method.description: Whether [param vehicle] is a vehicle.

method.name: vehicle_free
method.description: Frees [param vehicle] and its cabins.

method.name: vehicle_generic_component_find
method.description: The scripted components of [param vehicle] carrying [param tag], a tag of the modder's own choosing.

method.name: vehicle_get_cabin_count
method.description: How many cabins [param vehicle] has.

method.name: vehicle_get_cabins
method.description: The cabins of [param vehicle], in the order they were attached.

method.name: vehicle_get_commands
method.description: Returns the commands [param vehicle] answers to.

method.name: vehicle_get_controller
method.description: The controller the vehicle runs on - the copy its simulation was built from, null without one.

method.name: vehicle_get_dimensions
method.description: Width (x), height (y) and length (z) of the body of [param vehicle] [m], in the vehicle's own frame.

method.name: vehicle_get_id
method.description: Returns the vehicle's id - its scenery name in lower case, as the original reads it. An event, the console or a script finds the vehicle by it ([method vehicle_get_rid_by_id]); it is not shown to the player ([method vehicle_get_name]).

method.name: vehicle_get_name
method.description: Returns the vehicle's name as the scenery writes it, for the player to read - its id when it has none. Nothing is found by it.

method.name: vehicle_get_position
method.description: Where the vehicle is in the world, as whichever server places it set it.

method.name: vehicle_get_rid_by_id
method.description: Returns the vehicle with the id [param id] ([method vehicle_set_id]), or an invalid RID.

method.name: vehicle_get_rids
method.description: Returns the handles of every vehicle the server holds.

method.name: vehicle_get_speed
method.description: How fast [param vehicle] moves [km/h], whichever way.

method.name: vehicle_get_velocity
method.description: The velocity of [param vehicle] along its own front [m/s], negative backwards.

method.name: vehicle_has_command
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param vehicle] answers to [param command] - a component that registers it is present.

method.name: vehicle_has_person_role
method.description: Whether somebody sits in any cabin of [param vehicle] in [param role] - anybody for [constant VehiclePersonRole.VEHICLE_PERSON_ROLE_ANY].

method.name: vehicle_is_simulation_ready
method.description: Whether the simulation behind [param vehicle] exists yet - nothing can be read off a vehicle before it does.

method.name: vehicle_list_persons
method.description: Who sits in any cabin of [param vehicle] in [param role] - everybody for [constant VehiclePersonRole.VEHICLE_PERSON_ROLE_ANY].

method.name: vehicle_send_command
method.description: Sends [param command] to [param vehicle] by its handle and returns what its handler answered (whether the command was accepted), or [code]null[/code] when the vehicle has no such command. A vehicle is reached by its handle whatever its scenery name - use [method vehicle_get_rid_by_id] to find one by its id.

method.name: vehicle_set_id
method.description: Sets the vehicle's id, which [method vehicle_get_rid_by_id] finds it by and its controller takes as [member VehicleController.vehicle_id]. An empty id, or [code]"none"[/code], is not looked up.

method.name: vehicle_set_initial_velocity
method.description: What the scenery placed [param vehicle] with - the velocity it starts with, along its own front, negated for a reversed vehicle ([code]DynObj.cpp:2019[/code]). Handed to its controller when it is bound.

method.name: vehicle_set_name
method.description: Sets the vehicle's name as the scenery writes it, for the player to read ([method vehicle_get_name]).

signal.name: cabin_person_entered
signal.description: [param person] sat down in [param cabin], in [param role].

signal.name: cabin_person_moved
signal.description: [param person] went over from the cabin [param previous] to [param cabin] - of the same vehicle or, through a gangway, of another one - in the role it had.

signal.name: vehicle_cabin_detached
signal.description: [param cabin] is no part of [param vehicle] any more - detached or freed, everybody out first.

signal.name: vehicle_config_changed
signal.description: A component of [param vehicle] (re)applied its configuration.

signal.name: vehicle_configured
signal.description: The simulation behind [param vehicle] exists and carries its configuration.

signal.name: vehicle_controller_changed
signal.description: Another controller drives [param vehicle] now - whoever relays its events reconnects.

signal.name: vehicle_freed
signal.description: [param vehicle] was freed; its handle is not reused.
